title: About the Active Directory Issue Safelist

blocks.text: After you scan an Active Directory (AD) domain, the issues are listed under the Focus Area section on the Identity Posture dashboard. You can review these issues to confirm that it is not a risk and mark them as safe.
Adding issues to the safelist impacts the unified risk score on the Identity Posture dashboard.
Active Directory Issue Safelist provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Review the issue that does not pose a risk and mark it as safe.
Reduce the unified risk score on the Identity Posture dashboard.

blocks.heading: About the Active Directory Issue Safelist Page

blocks.text: On the Active Directory Issue Safelist page (ITDR > Settings > Active Directory Issue Safelist), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select an AD domain from the Result for drop-down menu.
View list of issues that are marked safe. For each issue, you can view:
Name: The name of the issue.
Created On: The date when the issue was added to the safelist.
Created By: The name of the user who added the issue to the safelist.
Reason: The reason why the issue was added to the safelist.
Delete an issue from the safelist.
